title: Configuration window unclear on invalid background image settings
line: Fifteen Puzzle settings now warn when the background image is missing or can't be loaded, instead of silently using the color.
explanation: With Background set to Image, the Appearance page accepted an empty path or a file that isn't a loadable image without any hint. The board then silently fell back to the plain color, and reopening the settings still showed Image selected as if it worked. The page now loads the chosen path in a hidden Image (with the path turned into a proper file URL) and, while Image is selected and it fails or no path is set, shows a warning header saying the background color will be used instead.

commits.message:
applets/fifteenPuzzle: warn when the background image can't be loaded

The settings accepted an empty path or a file that isn't a loadable image
without any hint, while the widget silently fell back to the color. Now the
Appearance page shows a warning when the chosen image can't be used.

BUG: 504914

media.caption: origin/master's Kirigami.Forms page with Image set to /etc/hostname (not an image): no warning, the board keeps the plain color.
Same setting: the page now warns that the image can't be loaded and the color is used.
A real PNG whose name contains '#' and '?': no warning.
Image selected with an empty path: warning that no image is selected.
After applying the '#'/'?' path the board draws that image, so the probe agrees with what the widget loads.

reviews.text: Using a Kirigami.InlineMessage warning header on SimpleKCM backed by a hidden asynchronous Image probe cleanly informs users when the selected background image is missing or cannot be loaded. Constructing the file URL via URL.pathname properly handles '#', '?', spaces, and non-ASCII characters (verified with tile#1?.png), and the before/after screenshots confirm crisp Kirigami HIG presentation without regressions.
